responsibility: Lists the machine-specific x86 builtin function descriptors that tie public builtin names to ISA requirements, rtl insn codes, comparison semantics, and builtin type signatures. Included multiple times with different BDESC macros, this file is the central declarative table from which the i386 backend builds builtin enumerators, descriptor arrays, and range boundaries for SSE, AVX, XOP, CET, and related builtin families.
